reader.requirement: At 1985 the ADVANCING identifier-2 must reference an integer data item, a numeric data item with no digit position to the right of the decimal point (signed or unsigned, any numeric USAGE, P-scaled to the left allowed); a non-integer numeric, alphanumeric, numeric-edited, group, index or reference-modified item is refused, and a function-identifier is refused because §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4 confines an integer or numeric function to an arithmetic expression.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: a numeric or integer function-identifier outside an arithmetic expression is COBOL0900 below 2002
BEFORE and AFTER together refused below 2023 (not the operand class)

reader.edition-search: grep of SequentialIoBinder.cs and OperandClassScreen.cs for DialectLevel/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/Permissive: the integer-item screen itself consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a function-identifier as identifier-2 is refused at 85 (1985 restricts integer functions to arithmetic expressions) and screened by its result class from 2002; the data-item screen is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers accepted DISPLAY, signed BINARY and PACKED integer items and a zero literal; the refusal half (non-integer, alphanumeric, edited, group, index, reference-modified, function) and a P-scaled integer are not exercised

probes.expected: S9(3)=+2, 9PP=0, 9(18)=3 (largest digits), S9(5) COMP-3=1 and 9=2 are integer data items; LINAGE-COUNTER 1+2+0+3+1+2 (§1985:VII.4.7.4 GR17)

probes.printed: COBOL2365 for N-DEC (9V9), N-X (PIC X), N-GRP (group), N-ED (Z9), N-IDX (USAGE INDEX), N-PP (PP9), N-NUM (1:1) (reference-modified); COBOL0900 + COBOL2365 for FUNCTION SQRT (4); COBOL1639 for an undefined name
probes.expected: each operand that is not an integer data item is refused

reader.notes: ScreenAdvancingCount sends identifier-2 to the WriteAdvancingIdentifier row of the one operand-class screen (IntegerItem = fixed-point numeric of scale <= 0), which matches the 1985 glossary's integer data item; the 1985-only function refusal comes from IntrinsicBinder's ConstructRegistry gate. Every probed shape behaves as the 1985 text requires.

refuter.evidence: r4a.cob (r4a-001): identifier-2 as a table element subscripted by an index-name TB (IX) and by a literal TB (3), a qualified SIGN LEADING SEPARATE item SL OF G2, a SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE item, USAGE COMPUTATIONAL and USAGE BINARY integers: all accepted, LINAGE-COUNTER 3/6/8/9/12/14 (1+2+3+2+1+3+2) as GR16a gives. The integer function refusal at 85 is right: cite.py OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4 ("A function-identifier which references an integer or numeric function may be used only in an arithmetic expression").
